My rating would be 5 stars if these had a stronger hold. These usually start losing their magnetic abilities and start detaching from the eyeliner after 2 hours of use, when I'm out and about. reviews.t: No Animal Testing on these Lashes!

I can even wear my glasses.  If you've ever tried false lashes and the glue was gloppy and the lashes wouldn't stay in place; then you'll love these! Ok so I got these cause using glue scares me. But I want to try the false lashed. I have tried and tried and tried to apply them. I have had several others try to apply them for me. A couple were pros. But I just can not get them on to where they stay more than a few mins. I contacted seller. They are GREAT!  They got back to me right away. Answered my questions. And then they talked me through the application process.  I dont think the product is bad I just think I'm not good with lashes.

Easy to apply and it's great for the price but it is very hard to remove the eyeliner. I had to scrub it off with make up remover and it took some eyelashes off while doing it. But on that note the eyeliner did last the whole day with no smudging so I guess it's a give and take. I'm still overall happy with it I'll just use my regular eyeliner for my wing and only use the magnetic eyeliner as a thin layer on top of the regular liner. Hopefully it'll make it easier to take off.

reviews.t: So many options for different occasions!
reviews.x: I am loving these lashes! I’ve always been iffy about the glue false lashes because of the process of putting them on but the magnetic liner is a complete game changer! So excited to wear them out!

The magnets don't feel very strong either pulling them off the tray. I didn't even bother testing the eyeliner. That's what I get for buying the cheapest set. reviews.t: Easy to apply and look great!
reviews.x: These are some serious lashes, feel like I'm going to flutter away!! I absolutely love them! They're so easy to apply compared to their glued cousin lashes. I am cursed with very fine lashes (as you can see by my almost non-existent lower lashes), these lashes are excellent! I bought them as a Halloween costume addition, but for some of the shorter and more natural length ones, I may wear them day-to-day!

I like they made my lashes fuller  the only thing I don't like is you can feel the corners lifting up and poking your eye lids and you can't cut them down on the end because the magnets are there ill try them a few more times and see if I can place them differently

reviews.t: Easy to apply and stays on
reviews.x: The eyeliner was easy to use and went on smooth. I recommend reapplying the eyeliner once it dries, otherwise the lashes don't stay on as long. But I wore mine all day today and they did not lift.
I love these magnetic lashes!  I don’t usually buy lashes but I couldn’t resist since these are so dark and lovely.  I wear them and feel more prepared because they are so easy to get used to.
Absolutely Love! They are easy to put on and remove especially for someone like me who has never used false eyelashes before!
I love these lashes! Once they are on they are on. They are so natural looking and user friendly!

reviews.x: This is my first time using magnetic lashes, and I’m glad I purchased this item, because it’s easy to use, apply and take off. I also like that there’s a variety of lashes you can choose from depending on which lash will match your look. claims.text: Many reviewers find the magnetic lashes easy to apply, especially compared to glue-on lashes.
Several reviewers report that the lashes or liner do not hold well and start lifting or losing their magnetic grip after a few hours.
Reviewers appreciate the variety of styles included in the set, from natural to glam.
Some reviewers find the eyeliner difficult to apply or remove, with removal requiring heavy scrubbing that can irritate the eyes.
A few reviewers mention quality issues such as loose or misdirected lashes and weak magnets.
